recipe.ghg_method: GWP100: EDGAR-compatible IPCC AR5 for mass-reported CO₂ (1), CH₄ (28), N₂O (265), SF₆ (23,500); HFC/PFC retain source CO₂-equivalents with unverified GWP basis. Biogenic CO₂ excluded. Production accounts; direct final-demand emissions calculated separately and included once in Whole economy. This release does not separately report biogenic combustion CH₄; its native combustion CH₄ row uses 28.

recipe.gdp_note: Source SUT value added, in EUR, matches the same-release/year IOT activity by activity. Its verified final-use product-tax bridge and satellite accounts are supplied by that exact matching IOT.
recipe.gdp_basis: GDP reconstructed with the source product-tax bridge

recipe.ghg_note: EXIOBASE: mass-reported gases use EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 (CH4=28). HFC/PFC already in source CO2eq retain their original characterisation; its IPCC basis is not independently verified. Production accounts and EDGAR territorial totals have different boundaries.
recipe.ghg_basis: Producer accounts plus direct final-demand emissions where supplied; AR5 (EDGAR CH4=28); source HFC/PFC CO2eq retained

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. MARIO calc_trades_content retains contributor origins and final consumers through a projected total-content solve; it does not construct a full inverse.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_trades_content retains production origins. Zero-output emissions stay a quantified unallocated production-origin residual. EXIOBASE: mass-reported gases use EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 (CH4=28). HFC/PFC already in source CO2eq retain their original characterisation; its IPCC basis is not independently verified. Production accounts and EDGAR territorial totals have different boundaries. Unallocated zero-output production emissions: 617.316 t CO2eq globally; retained by production origin, with no consumer allocation.
